I am a junior lecturer in the [Internet Engineering Technology (Teknologi Rekayasa Internet, TRI)](https://tri.sv.ugm.ac.id/) program at Universitas Gadjah Mada, Yogyakarta. My research focuses on **deep learning for computer vision and time series classification**, with work on eye tracking and medical image analysis.


## Research Interests

- Deep learning for computer vision
- Time series classification and eye tracking
- Medical image analysis
- Intelligent communication systems

## Education

**M.Eng. in [Information Technology](https://pasca.jteti.ugm.ac.id/)**, Universitas Gadjah Mada, 2025

**B.App.Eng. in [Internet Engineering Technology](https://tri.sv.ugm.ac.id/)**, Universitas Gadjah Mada, 2018
